name: broiler-farm-management-system
description: Production-grade Broiler Farm Management System with offline-first mobile app and web admin dashboard

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:mobile && npm run test:api
scripts.type-check: npm --workspace=@broiler/shared run type-check && npm --workspace=@broiler/api run type-check && npm --workspace=@broiler/mobile run type-check
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('apps/mobile/node_modules')) { try { fs.symlinkSync('../../node_modules', 'apps/mobile/node_modules', 'junction'); } catch(e){} }"
